title: Shared test coverage for AddItemSheet aisle picker persistence fix
description: Add and run focused regression coverage for the AddItemSheet aisle picker binding and manual-vs-programmatic selection behavior, while confirming existing related tests still pass.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover that a manual aisle change updates the effective selected aisle state after picker interaction.
Tests cover that manual selection blocks later auto-detect overrides as before.
Tests cover that programmatic last-used and auto-detect updates do not set the manual-selection flag.
Tests assert the Picker is wired to `$selectedAisle` rather than a custom binding, using the project's existing test approach where feasible.
Existing tests from `spec-e2aef2b8` continue to pass without required behavior changes outside this fix.
conflict_risks:
Low. Only AddItemSheet.swift was changed; no shared files touched.
None — only AddItemSheet.swift was modified, which is claimed solely by this bead.
